snippet.title: Lil Gator Game: In the Dark DLC | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get excited, friends! 💚💜 Lil Gator Game’s brand-new DLC, In the Dark, is splashing your way on 12 February 2026 – launching on the very same day as the Gator of the Year Edition, the complete Lil Gator Game package!

Venture into a massive underground world packed with hidden nooks, secret treasures, and plenty of new pals waiting to say hello. It’s a whole new adventure for your favourite lil hero.

The digital Gator of the Year Edition will be available on Nintendo Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. And that’s not all! There’s also a lovely new physical edition bundling both Lil Gator Game and In the Dark into one neat package, coming to PS5 and Nintendo Switch in early 2026.

Preorder the Gator of the Year Edition today:
https://direct.silverliningint.com/search?q=Lil+gator+game

And don’t forget to wishlist to support our lil adventurers!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3205060/Lil_Gator_Game_In_the_Dark
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/lil-gator-game-in-the-dark-70050000054231-switch/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/lil-gator-game-in-the-dark/9n0rpmb7x17f
